rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for an ordinary box or a boxful of contents, especially in 一盒 + contents.

example.english: One box of cookies is enough for four people.
example.traditional: 一盒曲奇夠四個人食喇。
example.jyutping: jat1 haap6 kuk1 kei4 gau3 sei3 go3 jan4 sik6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a compartment or cubby, and for a box or square on a form or screen.

example.english: This cabinet has several box compartments, so the socks can be sorted.
example.traditional: 呢個櫃有幾個格仔，啲襪可以分開擺。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gwai6 jau5 gei2 go3 gaak3 zai2 di1 mat6 ho2 ji5 fan1 hoi1 baai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a mailbox or post box.

example.english: I check the post box before work to see if there is any mail.
example.traditional: 我返工前會去郵箱睇下有冇信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 cin4 wui5 heoi3 jau4 soeng1 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 seon3

rows.note: Use this for a private box or compartment for spectators in a theatre or auditorium.

example.english: We booked a theatre box, so watching the show will be much more comfortable.
example.traditional: 我哋訂咗戲院嘅包廂，睇戲會舒服好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deng6 zo2 hei3 jyun2 ge3 baau1 soeng1 tai2 hei3 wui5 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1
